description: A quiet sensor-grid puzzler spanning 12 missions: place a limited set of sensors and use their readings to triangulate hidden targets. Bigger grids, tighter energy, and warp modifiers keep each mission tense.

title: Sliding Puzzle
description: The classic sliding-tile puzzle: shuffle the board, then slide tiles back into place to complete the picture. Tracks your moves and time while you solve.

title: Spin Match
description: A sixty-second rotation race: spin each figure to the exact target angle, then judge it.

title: Spot the Difference
description: A classic picture-hunt puzzler: two nearly identical scenes hide five differences, and you tap each one on the bottom picture to mark it. Hints and best scores are saved per scene.

title: Stack Tower
description: A one-tap neon stacking game: drop the sliding block, overhangs get trimmed, and pixel-perfect drops keep your width and build a combo. How tall can you raise the tower?

title: Stained Glass
description: Restore twelve stained-glass windows by fitting rotating panes so every seam color matches.

title: Star Ring Synthesis
description: Drop and fuse orbiting bodies into bigger masses to deliver target tiers to each band.

title: Starline Route
description: A star-chart routing puzzler: start from the assigned port and trace every route exactly once without lifting your finger. Undo, hints, and reference replays help you find the flawless path.

title: Starship Suspects
description: A starship-noir detective dossier across six cases: link pairs of evidence that explain each other, then file your triple accusation of crewmate, method, and motive. False links cost hints, and clean solves earn three stars.

title: Sudoku Studio
description: A guided number-logic academy with twelve lessons from classic 9x9 grids to diagonal and cage variants. Pencil-mark notes, a three-mistake limit, hints, and checks support every lesson.

title: Tide Grid
description: A pipe-rotation puzzle on a sinking island grid. Rotate tiles to wire tidal power from the source to every load across low, mid, and high water.

title: Tile Fusion
description: Slide pastel tiles and fuse equal numbers together on the road to the 2048 tile.

title: Tile Match Stack
description: Match open tile pairs to clear the stack before the timer ends.

title: Tower Stacker
description: A classic sliding-block tower stacker. Drop each gliding block so it lands flush — overhangs get trimmed, and a total miss ends the run.

title: Traffic Jam Escape
description: Slide blocking cars out of the way to free the red car through the exit before time runs out.

title: Trap the Cat
description: Corner a clever cat on an eleven-by-eleven hex board. Block tiles to cut off its escape, one step at a time.

title: Twin Courier
description: A time-bending route puzzle with two couriers. Guide the past and future couriers to their deliveries — past deliveries unlock new roads — and finish under par.

title: Wire Blueprint
description: Wire six blueprint puzzles from battery to bulbs. Rotate every segment until current flows along one continuous path to each light.

title: Wordfall Search
description: A timed word-search game: drag across letter grids to find every target word before the per-word timer runs out.

title: Angle Trainer
description: Train your eye for angles without a protractor. Guess the yellow angle in degrees and score by precision across quick rounds.

title: Arrow Snap Trainer
description: A 30-second reflex test: a big arrow flashes in the center and you tap the matching button as fast as you can.

title: Courtroom Clash
description: Defend six court cases: press witnesses line by line, present the right evidence, and deliver the closing argument.

title: Cube Volume Quiz
description: A 60-second arithmetic sprint with 3D cube stacks. Read the side length and type the exact volume — as many as you can.

title: Day Drill
description: A date-to-weekday drill spanning 1600 to 2399. Name the weekday for any date with seven-button picks, split practice, and response-time stats.

title: Flag Signal Quiz
description: Decode sailor flag signals letter by letter: study the semaphore chart, then spell each hidden word.

title: Flash Recall
description: Memorize flashing symbols, then tap them back in the exact order across quick rounds.

title: Hold Measure
description: Test your eye for distance: press and hold to grow a bar, release to lock it, and land as close to the hidden length as you can.

title: Hot or Cold Numbers
description: Guess the secret number from 1 to 100 using hotter-or-colder hints after every try.

title: Logic Gate Lab
description: Toggle inputs, switch gate types, and predict what the live circuit lamp will show.

title: Number Sequence
description: Spot the pattern in each number series and type the missing term before your streak breaks.

title: Opposites Rush
description: A lightning word duel against the clock. Tap the exact opposite of each word before the bar drains to build streaks and levels.

title: Path Quiz
description: Trace the shortest route from start to finish on each grid and beat the optimal step count.

title: Pocket City Campaign
description: A pocket city-building campaign across twelve cities: zone blocks, set policies, and balance happiness, reserves, and pollution over 8-year terms. Progress saves automatically and exports to a shareable code.

title: Sorting Game
description: A 30-second sorting sprint: one grocery item at a time, tap the correct bin as fast as you can. Correct taps build a streak bonus while misses cost points.

title: Type Coercion Quiz
description: Answer eight tricky questions on scripting-language type conversion rules.

title: Peak Drift Tour
description: Race a nine-stop drift championship: slide corners to charge nitro, manage tire heat, and earn stars to unlock cars.

title: River Sprint
description: Steer a paddle racer down a bright river across three lanes, grabbing buoys and beating the clock.

title: Sailboat Sprint
description: Race a sailboat across three laps of open sea, collecting green flags while dodging rocks and buoys.

title: Signal Caravan
description: A road-escort adventure across twelve routes where you slide a shielded caravan along the road while its auto-pulse fires at raiders. Spend spare parts on repairs, sweeps, and beacons to survive every wave.

title: Snow Ridge
description: A physics downhill racer across twelve fixed snow lines: beat the reference time for medals, grab flags, land spins for style, and stay crash-free for bonus stars. Riders and boards change how you handle, jump, and boost.

title: Dice Delver
description: Battle through three regions of dice combat: lock dice, build combos, and spend traveler skills to survive eighteen nodes.

title: Shan Hai Demon Queller
description: A card-battling expedition across 18 floors in 3 realms where you draft a hero, collect relics, and fight tactical turn-based battles. Block to negate damage, charge up attacks, and chain combos to bring down the demons.

title: Touchline Manager
description: A full dugout-management season across league and cup. Pick lineups and tactics, train and trade players, and call the shots on matchday.

title: Alien Dogfighter
description: Pilot a jet against endless alien squadrons. Blast waves of attackers, grab falling power-ups, and survive as long as you can.

title: Comet Weaver
description: Pilot a comet ship through twelve acts of bullet patterns, grazing edges to charge a blast that clears the veil.

title: Dusty Duel
description: Face quick-draw shooting duels in a pocket retro console with pixel art and fast rounds.

title: Heli Dusk Defense
description: Hold the rooftop at dusk in an attack helicopter. Blast climbing invaders, dodge thrown rocks, and survive escalating night waves.

title: Jungle Wave Shooter
description: Fight through night-jungle waves, moving vertically and firing right at incoming enemies.

title: Row-Descent Invaders
description: Hold the line against marching alien rows. Slide your cannon along the bottom and shatter each wave before it descends on you.

title: Sky Ace
description: A fast side-view air combat shooter. Steer your warplane through enemy waves and hold fire to blast them down — one hit ends the run.

title: Sky Striker
description: Slide along the bottom and blast the three-row sky formation before it reaches your line.

title: Space War
description: A neon starfield shooter: swipe or use arrows to steer, hold fire to spray bolts, grab stars for points, and survive to the boss that arrives every five waves.

title: Tank Battle
description: A top-down armor skirmish: roll with the D-pad or arrows, rotate your barrel independently, and blast wave after wave of enemy tanks. Survive the escalating assault.

title: Thunder
description: A vertical bullet-storm shooter: pilot your jet upward through enemy waves, blast foes to fill the power meter, then unleash a screen-clearing surge. A boss waits every five waves.

title: Thunder Vanguard
description: A vertical campaign shooter across five stations: pick a fighter with its own speed, fire, and storm charge, ride auto-fire through score targets, and hold storm to charge a bullet-clearing blast before each boss.

title: Acceleration Lab
description: A hands-on physics lab for speed and acceleration. Set acceleration, launch runs down a 100 m track, and compare velocity and distance.

title: Alchemy Lab
description: Brew magical potions to fill customer commissions. Tune heat, brew time, and apparatus to nail each recipe's purity and potency.

title: Battery Cycle Lab
description: Run a battery lab through twelve energy contracts. Dispatch charge, rest, load, and balance actions to hit energy goals while keeping every cell healthy.

title: Border Desk
description: Six days behind the border bureau desk. Inspect travel papers, flag anything doubtful, and stamp approve or deny — every mistake is a warning.

title: Clean Slate
description: Take on twelve cleaning commissions: match the right tool to each grime layer while managing supplies and surface damage.

title: Cozy Farm Grid
description: Plant seeds, harvest ripe crops, sell them for coins, and shoo crows across sunny farm levels.

title: Cozy Organizer
description: Tidy twelve messy rooms: rotate furniture into place while obeying wall and spacing rules.

title: Elemental Sand Lab
description: Sketch falling sands in a reaction lab, spark chain reactions between materials, and log them to finish nine studies.

title: Park Builder: World Tour
description: A theme-park builder across six cities. Lay paths, match rides to visitor tastes, set ticket prices, and keep parks clean to earn stars.

title: Pocket Companion
description: Raise a tiny pocket pal over twelve days: feed it, play with it, and shape which of eight final forms it grows into.

title: Pocket Pixel-8
description: A pocket fantasy console with three built-in cartridge games, retro sound, and automatic saves.

title: Sand Lab
description: A living falling-sand canvas with twenty-four powders, liquids, gases, and fire materials to pour and mix.

title: Tickworks
description: A tiny factory logistics puzzler. Lay sources, belts, and assemblers on a ticking grid to deliver contract quotas on budget.

title: Tide Salvage
description: A deep-sea diving expedition across five zones and sixteen relics. Dive for treasure, watch your oxygen and hull, and surface in time to bank the haul.

title: Tower Commander: Three-Port Rush
description: Run the tower across three busy airports over nine shifts. Vector planes, mind wake turbulence and weather, and land everyone safely.

title: Aurora Hockey
description: A neon air-hockey cup run across twelve seats. Read the bumpers, bend your angles, and outscore each rival to lift the cup.

title: Batting Blast
description: A pure timing duel between pitcher and batter. Watch the ball come in and swing at the perfect instant to launch home runs.

title: Bullseye Darts
description: Drag the dart back to aim, release to throw, and land closest to the bullseye across 3 rounds of darts.

title: Carnival Sprint
description: Pick one of four racers and watch a quick random sprint to the finish line.

title: Cartoon Archery
description: Pull back, aim, and loose arrows at a cartoon target. Read the wind, shape your trajectory, and chase bullseyes across each quiver.

title: Curling House
description: A full curling match: set aim, power, and curl, sweep your stones farther, and outscore the CPU over 4 ends.

title: En Garde Fencing
description: Slide on the fencing strip with reactive timing: advance, retreat, parry, and strike to land five touches first.

title: Flick Shootout
description: Flick the ball with drag controls and beat the moving keeper in fast shootout rounds.

title: Hoop Flick
description: Flick basketballs at the hoop across three timed rounds. Drag to aim, release to shoot, and chain clean swishes for combo bonuses.

title: Lake Cast
description: Two minutes on a lively lake. Charge your cast for distance, strike the instant a fish tugs, and reel it in without snapping tension.

title: Meadow Archery
description: Loose arrows across a breezy sky meadow. Fight wind and wobble to group your shots, and hit bonus birds for extra points.

title: Mini Golf Putt
description: Putt through six tricky mini-golf holes in as few strokes as possible.

title: Pocket Golf: Three-Course Tour
description: Putt through an eighteen-hole, three-course golf tour with sand, ice, water, and wind physics.

title: Pocket Lane Bowling
description: Ten pins, one lane, and pure aim. Set your angle, roll with physics, and chase the strike across realistic pin action.

title: Pond Fishing
description: Time your cast on a moving meter, watch the bobber, and hook the instant it dips to land the biggest catch in 60 seconds.

title: Shuttle Rally
description: Keep a fluttering shuttlecock alive in a breezy rally. Slide your racket, smash winners, and stretch every rally longer than the last.

title: Soccer
description: A quick penalty-flick shootout: drag back from the ball and flick it past the diving keeper. Aim for the corners, because no keeper can save a perfect shot.

title: Spot-Kick Shootout
description: Take five-shot penalty seasons: pick a corner, set your power, and beat the keeper.

title: Stone Slide Curling
description: Solve twelve curling puzzle ends: slide three stones past gold guards to the button while staying under par energy.

title: Table Hockey Duel
description: Drag your paddle and strike the puck past the computer defender in a fast table-hockey duel.

title: Tennis
description: A split-court bat-and-ball rally against a tracking AI: slide your left paddle to return every shot as the ball speeds up each rally. Every return scores, so how long can you keep it alive?

title: Tide Harbor
description: Read the tides and fight fish by day, then run the harbor market and workshop by dusk across an open-sea season.

title: Abyss Sonar
description: Command a submarine on stealth dives through dangerous waters. Manage noise, ping contacts, and slip past threats to complete eight dives.

title: Basin Control
description: Hold back the flood across twelve drills. Read rain forecasts and run two reservoirs to shave the downstream peak without breaking eco-flow or power goals.

title: Crystal Vanguard
description: Pick a hero, push three lanes with minions, draft star pacts, and destroy the enemy core.

title: Deep Fleet
description: Command silent fleets through six fixed sea zones, using sonar scans to trade cannon salvos in turn-based duels.

title: Ember Tactics
description: Lead six heroes through nine tactical grid battles across three chapters, drafting trios and sigils for each mission.

title: Frontline Command
description: Command a three-lane base defense across five chapters, spending ore and power to hold the outpost.

title: Garden Front
description: Plant sprout defenders along garden lanes to hold back waves across six blooming realms.

title: Gavel Duel
description: A turn-based auction duel over eight antique lots. Outbid two rivals with distinct habits, and never pay more than a lot is worth.

title: Hive Queen
description: Guide a bee colony through four twelve-day seasons by assigning jobs, raising facilities, and surviving weather.

title: Retro Base Defense
description: Hold your cannon line against descending invaders while sheltering behind crumbling bricks.

title: Signal Voyage
description: Twelve nights aboard the deep-space relay Errant. Read each night's scene, ration bandwidth, and choose actions that steer the crew toward one of many endings.

title: Souk Surge
description: A sixty-second market dash where prices never sit still. Roll fresh prices, buy low, sell high, and bank your profit before time runs out.

title: Starforge Workshop
description: An idle fleet-building game: construct ships for passive power, spend energy on calibration and overcharge bursts, and buy lab research that multiplies all production. Progress saves automatically.

title: Switchyard Rush
description: A railway-dispatch shift across twelve timetables: tap incoming trains and route each type to its color line, with medical trains paying priority points. Signals and holds keep the yard flowing.

title: Valley Almanac
description: Run a cozy valley farm through the seasons: till, water, plant, and harvest crops while befriending the village.

title: Code 5
description: A five-letter word deduction game. Guess the secret word in six tries with green, gold, and gray tile clues after every guess.

title: Switchword
description: A word-ladder party: climb from the start word to the target by changing exactly one letter per step, every step a real word. Timed rounds, streaks, undo, and hints keep the climb lively.
